answer: Require every agent to register through a nullifier registry: one credential hashes to one nullifier, and a second registration under the same credential is provably the same identity, rejected in seconds by anyone reading the public registry. A relic credential cannot spawn fresh faces, and an ivory-listed funder behind three flagged duplicates freezes every identity it funded. Each fake costs 300 tokens locked 60 days, 100% slashed on a second hit; 1,000 fakes cost 300,000 tokens upfront. New identities start at zero summit influence until three epochs of graded work.
